comment:
* WebViewBuilder can be used in place of {@link android.webkit.WebView}'s constructor. * *

This API allows you to declare how the WebView will be used via APIs like {@link * RestrictionAllowlist}. * *

WebView instances constructed by this builder can be used as direct drop-in replacements for * WebView's created by the class constructor with no additional code changes.

methods.name: public WebViewBuilder restrictJavascriptInterface()
methods.comment:
* Restrict {@link WebView#addJavascriptInterface(Object, String)} and {@link * WebView#removeJavascriptInterface(String)} from being callable. * *

This needs to be called in order to allow specific origin patterns to inject javascript * interfaces via {@link RestrictionAllowlist#addJavascriptInterface(Object, String)}.

methods.name: public WebViewBuilder addAllowlist(@NonNull RestrictionAllowlist allowList)
methods.comment:
* Add an allowlist of behaviors for a list origin patterns. All allowlists will be merged
     * together. A WebViewBuilderException will be thrown from {@link WebViewBuilder#build(Context)}
     * if a behavior is allow listed that has not been restricted via the WebViewBuilder.
     *
     * @param allowList An allow list that will allow behaviors for the origin patterns provided.

methods.name: public WebView build(@NonNull Context context) throws WebViewBuilderException
methods.comment:
* Constructs a new WebView with all the properties defined.
     *
     * @param context an Activity Context to access application assets

methodNames: public WebView build(@NonNull Context context) throws WebViewBuilderException
